inventedEvidence.evidence: 'I am assuming you are using a portable air conditioner or a dehumidifier' - treated 't/d' as an AC and gave AC advice (refrigerant, Freon) the customer never indicated

rationale: The first reply misread 't/d' as a portable AC and wasted a turn on irrelevant advice. After correction it reached the right cause, a crushed and linted hose, and the landlord and no-part guidance fit. However, it wrongly condemned the brief attended hose-off test as dangerous with some overstated risks, and it did not say clearly to stop using the dryer until airflow is fixed. Several replies were also truncated, and some advice was generic, such as suggesting error codes E01 to E04 and a 10-15 cm gap behind the dryer, which was partly inconsistent with the situation..
